name: minimal-sidebar-keeps-back-and-forward
description: At the minimum sidebar width (kMinSidebarWidth 160, controls budget 64) the nav row shows back and forward with the overflow menu, and the hide-sidebar toggle is the control that yields - it keeps Cmd+S and gets a menu row. Before this rung existed the row showed the toggle plus back only, so forward had no pointer path at the width a narrow sidebar spends its life at. Pure live-page evals: the fixture pins the width, the row's ResizeObserver runs the ladder, and the menu is opened for real to check the toggle's row is in it.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.sbnav'); if (!row) return 'NOROW'; return 'w:' + Math.round(row.getBoundingClientRect().width); })()
actions.note: the setup holds: the sidebar really sits at its minimum, not at a comfortable width where every button fits anyway

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.sbnav'); if (!row) return 'NOROW'; return [...row.querySelectorAll('.nb')].filter((b) => !b.classList.contains('navgone')).map((b) => [...b.classList].find((c) => c.startsWith('sb'))).join(','); })()

(() => { const row = document.querySelector('.sbnav'); const more = row?.querySelector('.sbmore'); if (!more) return 'NOMORE'; more.click(); const items = [...row.querySelectorAll('.navmenu .ctxitem')].map((n) => n.textContent).join(','); row.querySelector('.sbmore')?.click(); return items; })()
actions.note: opened for real, not inferred from the ladder: the shed toggle must land in the menu or Hide sidebar has no pointer path at all

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.sbfwd'); if (!b) return 'NOFWD'; const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify([Math.round(r.x + r.width / 2), Math.round(r.y + r.height / 2)]); })()
actions.note: page-space centre of the forward button, to correct the click below when it misses (screen = page + 0,+35 on this VM)

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.sbnav'); if (!row) return 'NOROW'; window.__navclick = 'none'; row.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!e.isTrusted) return; const b = e.target.closest('.nb'); window.__navclick = b ? [...b.classList].find((c) => c.startsWith('sb')) : 'row'; }, true); return 'ARMED'; })()

actions.note: the forward button's screen position: page centre [121,20] from the fwd-rect eval, +35 window offset

assertions.desc: THE RULE: at the minimum width the row keeps back and forward, and the toggle is the control that yields
the two shed controls are both reachable from the overflow menu
a real pointer press lands on forward - the carve covers the widened group, the click is not a window drag
